 Rayo Vallecano vs Elche Prediction, 10/25/2026 Soccer Pick, Tips and Odds
 by Tony Sink - 10/20/2026 
 Game: Rayo Vallecano vs Elche
 Date: Sunday, October 25, 2026
 Location: Estadio de Vallecas in Madrid, Spain
 TV: ESPN+, Premier Sports
 Estadio de Vallecas in Madrid, Spain is the location where Elche (1-4-4) will try to beat Rayo Vallecano (2-3-3) on Sunday. Rayo Vallecano are priced at -160 while Elche are priced +132. The over/under is set at 3. The expected starting goaltenders are Emil Audero for Rayo Vallecano and Matias Dituro for Elche.
 The Red Sashes have conceded 17 goals while allowing 2.13 goals per 90, and their oppositition have accounted for 43 shots on target against them. The team hasn't compiled a clean sheet for the season. Rayo Vallecano has amassed 20 yellow cards for the season as well as 2 red cards. This season, the squad sports an average of 1.13 pts per fixture (9 points) and they also sit at 8th among European teams with 9 assists. The Red Sashes have a rank of 7th concerning goals expected with 21.4, and the team's expected goals against are sitting at 22.9. This team's goal differential is currently at -5 by means of 12 goals tallied and 17 goals conceded. Rayo Vallecano has amassed 26 SVs and have earned a SV percentage of 60.5% so far this season.

 The Green-Striped Ones average 0.8 points per fixture while tallying 10 assists and 1 red card. Elche sits at 15th when talking about goals conceded having 17, and the goal difference is sitting at -6. Elche CF has earned a clean sheet rate of 22.2% so far this year in addition to 22 yellow cards. This year, Elche CF has a save % of 58.5% (41 shots on target against), and they also have a rank of 18th among European teams with 7 points. The team's goals against per 90 is currently at 1.89 in addition to 24 saves, and they have amassed 2 shut outs. Elche has amassed 11 goals and their expected goals this year sits at 19.1.
 The man who will protect the net for Rayo Vallecano will be Emil Audero. Audero has defended the goal for 24,527 minutes and has earned 819 stops in his career. His goals allowed per 90 minutes is 1.46 (398 total goals allowed) and he has earned a save % of 67.4%. The keeper hailing from Indonesia has faced 1,216 shots attempted against him in 273 starts. Audero (88-62-123 record during his soccer career) has recorded 67 shutouts, which has earned him a 24.6%% shutout percentage.
 Matias Dituro is expected to look after the net for Elche. So far in his career, Dituro has surrendered 319 goals and has earned 763 saves in 380 starts. He has earned a save percentage of 70.5% and his shutout rate is currently 32.6%%. He has allowed 0.84 goals per 90 minutes while he holds a mark of 170-99-111. Dituro has earned 124 clean sheets and has defended 1,083 shots tried against him in 34,199 career minutes.
 Alvaro Garcia is one footballer who can make a noticable difference for Rayo Vallecano. The midfielder from Spain has earned 65 goals scored in 31,045 mins. Garcia has been given a starting assignment in 344 outings during his pro soccer career while scoring 0.19 G/90. He has totaled 59 assists while tallying 189 pts in his career.
 Elche features an attacker in Thomas Lemar, who is a thorn in the side of defenses. He has totaled 122 points in his career and has helped on a goal 52 times. The midfielder representing France has accumulated 20,472 mins while scoring 35 goals. He scores 0.15 goals per 90 mins and has had a starting assignment in 231 contests in his career.

 Tony Sink's Pick: Take Elche (-160)
